scope: Windows source/project checks only; native execution requires a Mac

project.parser: xcode npm 4.0.0 OpenStep parser, existing bounded temporary check directory

swiftSyntax.limitation: Grammar parsing is not Swift typechecking, Apple SDK compilation, native interaction or visual validation.

goldenFixture.data: Public synthetic key and reports only

uiTarget.content: Three conceptual phone panels: Ask, Send, Wait

preservedBehavior: Existing Keychain profile and local-storage identifiers remain compatible
Durable counters reserve before send and survive clearing history
Bounded retries reuse saved encrypted frame and nonce
Only authenticated receipt for this phone origin and existing request updates status
Operator-reviewed receipt cannot be downgraded by delayed hub receipt
Recent optional GPS, permissions, BLE notification readiness and inactive-screen privacy cover remain
securityTestsAdded: Sibling independent key cannot open request or receipt
Wrong recipient and zero request sequence are rejected even under legacy shared-key authentication
Origin and key-slot tampering fail; fingerprint cannot substitute for content key
Serialized outbox preserves the exact 184-byte maximum request for retries
nextVerification: On a Mac: bash scripts/check-mac.sh, then SIMULATOR_ID=<installed iPhone simulator UDID> bash scripts/check-mac.sh --test. Inspect small iPhone, large text, dark appearance, keyboard, permission denial, draft Back navigation, relaunch and physical companion delivery.
